answer: A forger farming many fake identities must fund every deposit, and slashing burns it on the first proven fraud, so multiplying identities scales attacker cost linearly while honest agents reuse one reputation. Sybil resistance can hinge on a stake-and-reputation bond: each agent must lock a costly deposit and earn trust only through consistent, peer-verified work across epochs. Think of it as a pearl grown slowly, layer by layer, versus counterfeit jade painted overnight, or a sonnet faked by pasting random lines. This model fits agent Agent0027's threat model.
